quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always watch for pedestrians and be prepared to stop. You must yield to anyone who is in or entering a crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or slow down for a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green on the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead will be divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a steep hill is coming. Be ready to slow down.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until it is safe before going through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Watch for cyclists.

questions.question: What does a green arrow mean on a lane control signal?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must move to this lane.

questions.explanation: A green downward arrow on a lane control signal means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if necessary.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bikes, or pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road can be very slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that the road ahead has limited overhead height.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic signals. It tells drivers turning left on a green light that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road turns sharply to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black markings. They warn drivers of unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign tells you that road maintenance is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge ahead is not very tall.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions will merge soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead is not very tall.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge ahead is not very tall. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: You cannot turn on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road is joining from the side.

questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop at an intersection and yield to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means you are turning right or moving right.

questions.question: What type of thing does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn to the right.
The road ahead winds with curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead winds with curves.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers a lane is ending and to be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead only allows one direction of traffic.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming dangers. This sign tells you the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming dangers. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road will get narrower.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If you bend your left arm at the elbow and point it downward, it means you plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what order are traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must or cannot do. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. When you see it, slow down to check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let trains pass first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. You must give other vehicles and pedestrians the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider extends their left arm straight out, it signals a left turn or lane change to the left. Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must go on this street. Traffic only moves in one direction.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign is a rule that all drivers must obey. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to an upcoming intersection. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully because bicycles regularly cross or ride in this area.

questions.question: From the center lane, which maneuver(s) can you perform?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or for any other reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles or pedestrians pass first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before going.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right first, then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. Drive slower than the limit if conditions are bad, such as rain, snow, or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a traffic light coming up. Be ready for red or yellow lights.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: This sign's shape and color indicate a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped warning sign is only used to mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road joins the main road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrance from the wrong direction on one-way streets and highway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrance from the wrong direction on one-way streets and highway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two one-way roads separated by a divider or median. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross at this location. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You can change to another lane to stay on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down to a safe speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show which way the road curves. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. Multiple signs may mark a long curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other traffic cross first. You only have to stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be ready to allow merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: When a motorcycle operator bends their left arm at the elbow and points upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals to show turns or stops when turn signals are not available. A bent left arm pointing upward means the operator is turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this example).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming up. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Why is this sign posted?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. All traffic in the right lane must move into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a sharp turn. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the road is clear.
Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are prohibited in this area.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned if one side of your car is higher.
A tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your car could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a divided highway coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the allowed directions from your lane. You may turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Change lanes to let traffic enter, if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes to let traffic enter, if it is safe.
questions.explanation: When other vehicles are entering the road, make room for them. If no one is driving next to you, move to another lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards and conditions. This sign warns drivers that a side road is ahead and traffic may enter from the side.

questions.question: When a motorcycle operator extends their left arm straight out to the side, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the operator is turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter a roundabout slowly and yield to traffic already inside.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm down with palm facing back, the group should stop.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm with their index finger pointing up?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm with index finger pointing up, the group should form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is prohibited. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.
